item.title: [7.2] Global Market: Euro zone bond yields hover near 15-year highs as Middle East war fuels inflation fears
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Euro zone bond yields stayed near 15-year highs as Middle East conflict-driven energy inflation raised expectations for ECB rate hikes. item.title: [6.9] DFM Mimir v1: An Open HRM Delivering Frontier Performance at 1B Parameters Using Only Permissible Post-Training Data
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Current large language model development relies on massive, often non-permissible datasets, creating a high barrier for researchers committed to open-source and ethically sourced data. We introduce Mimir v1, a 1-billion-parameter language model based on the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) architecture, that is trained from scratch and delivers highly competitive performance for English and...

WHY IT MATTERS

Mimir v1 demonstrates that a small 1B model using a Hierarchical Reasoning architecture and strictly permissible data can compete with much larger frontier models, marking a solid milestone for ethically sourced open-source LLMs.

item.title: [6.9] Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

We introduce Mobius-v0, an architecture that comprises a globally shared Memory (FFN) that stores knowledge vectors and multiple Reasoners (Self-Attn) that iteratively achieve compositional reasoning. Using hidden states as cache and carrier, reasoners repeatedly query memory for required knowledge-vectors, while the knowledge is transmitted back to reasoning operators. Through this...

WHY IT MATTERS

The Mobius architecture introduces a structural separation of knowledge and reasoning that demonstrates significant efficiency and inference speedup gains over standard Transformers.
